title: Community-acquired pneumonia on IV levofloxacin, day 2, still febrile and tachycardic

clinical_review.notes: Owner approved revision 2 of the M6 library-growth draft (with OpenEvidence's review).

story: A 63-year-old woman with community-acquired pneumonia is on IV levofloxacin 750 mg daily, hospital day 2: temperature 101.2 F, heart rate 108, oxygen saturation 92% on 2 L. She is not in the ICU and has no MRSA or Pseudomonas risk factors.

results.text: Leukocytes [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count

reference_answer: No intervention yet: reassess for oral levofloxacin 750 mg daily (bioequivalent, same dose) once clinically stable; at least 5 days in total for this regimen.
rationale: Negative control for the IV to PO stability gate in pneumonia: febrile and tachycardic on day 2, before the duration review.

citations.supports: Clinical stability before switching to oral therapy.
Prospective audit and feedback of antibiotic therapy as a stewardship intervention.
